title: Beyond Extractives: Unlocking Mauritania’s Potential for a Sustained, Inclusive and Resilient Growth (Country Growth and Jobs Report 2025)
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and drought impacts since 1950 and 2020-2022; modeled climate impacts to 2050
methodology: Country report combines climate-risk discussion and modeled growth impacts.
limitations: Macroeconomic estimates depend on climate/adaptation scenarios; drought impact is an upper-bound share.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: G5 Sahel
temporal_coverage: Country-specific growth, climate, and poverty scenarios to 2050
methodology: The G5 CCDR models each country separately and links macro projections to household-survey microsimulation.
limitations: Regional framing includes four other countries; distributional modeling does not account for household location or characteristics.
